# 0xTsoa

> 0xTsoa (pronounced ZeroTsoa) is an open-source registry of reproducible Linux desktop configurations, created by Ny Harena RAVELOMANANTSOA, a Malagasy developer.

Created by Ny Harena RAVELOMANANTSOA ([GitHub](https://github.com/nyharena25) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rnyharena-dev/)).

0xTsoa (spoken alias: **ZeroTsoa**) is a static registry built with Astro 7 (`output: 'static'`), Tailwind CSS v4, Zod 4, and Pagefind, deployed on Vercel at https://0xtsoa.vercel.app (and compatible with GitHub Pages sub-path builds). Every configuration is a standalone JSON file in Git (`configs/<author>/<slug>.json`), validated against a strict Zod/JSON Schema in CI and compiled into static HTML and JSON at build time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/): top-voted spotlight carousel, quick compositor/style links, and registry overview
- [Catalogue](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/catalogue/): full configuration index filterable by desktop part, compositor/WM, distribution and theme style (`?category=`, `?wm=`, `?style=`, `?distro=`, `?q=`), 10 per page (`?p=`), sorted by `?sort=new|old|votes|popular`
- [Contribute](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/contribute/): submission instructions for GitHub Issue Form and direct Pull Requests
- [About](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/about/): what 0xTsoa is, name origin, and creator profile (Ny Harena RAVELOMANANTSOA)
- Configuration detail pages: `https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/configs/<author>/<slug>/` (specifications table, pinned install script and SHA-256 digest, screenshot gallery, rendered upstream README, and keybindings)

## Machine-Readable Data

- [index.json](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/index.json): full registry exported as a JSON array of `CatalogueItem` objects
- [Sitemap](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap index covering all public pages and `/configs/<author>/<slug>/` routes

### `index.json` Entry Field Reference

Each item in `https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/index.json` contains:

- `id` (`string`): `<author>/<slug>` identifier matching `/configs/<author>/<slug>/`
- `name` (`string`): setup title (`3–80` chars)
- `author` (`{ name: string, github: string }`): maintainer display name and GitHub handle
- `summary` (`string`): one-sentence technical summary (`10–200` chars)
- `distros` (`string[]`): target distributions (`arch`, `endeavouros`, `manjaro`, `fedora`, `nixos`, `debian`, `ubuntu`, `mint`, `void`, `opensuse`, `gentoo`, `alpine`, `any`)
- `wm` (`string`): window manager or compositor (`hyprland`, `sway`, `river`, `niri`, `wayfire`, `labwc`, `i3`, `bspwm`, `awesome`, `qtile`, `xmonad`, `dwm`, `herbstluftwm`, `openbox`, `gnome`, `kde`, `xfce`, `cinnamon`, `cosmic`, `other`)
- `displayServer` (`"wayland" | "x11" | "both"`): display server protocol
- `tags` (`string[]`): lowercase kebab-case tags (up to 10)
- `specs` (`object`): optional component details (`bar`, `terminal`, `launcher`, `theme`, `shell`)
- `thumbUrl` (`string`): primary screenshot URL (from `screenshots[0].url`)
- `thumbAlt` (`string`): accessible description for the primary screenshot
- `version` (`string`, optional): configuration version string
- `updatedAt` (`string`): last modification date (`YYYY-MM-DD`)
- `votes` (`number`): community sign-off count snapshotted at build time

## Submission & Community Vote Flow

1. **Issue Form or Direct PR**: Contributors submit via the GitHub Issue Form (`new-config.yml`) or open a Pull Request adding `configs/<author>/<slug>.json`.
2. **Automated Bot PR (`issue-to-config`)**: When submitted via Issue Form, a GitHub Actions workflow parses the markdown fields, downloads any referenced install script to compute its SHA-256 hash if omitted, validates the payload with `configSchema`, and opens a Pull Request.
3. **CI Schema Validation**: Every PR runs `npm run validate` and `npm run check` (`astro check` + Vitest) to enforce schema rules, pinned Git refs, SHA-256 digests, and allowed image hosts.
4. **Community Vote Issue (`ensure-vote-issues` & `fetch-votes`)**: On merge, CI ensures a dedicated GitHub issue titled `[0xTsoa] <author>/<slug>` with label `vote` exists. Community members vote by reacting with `+1`, `heart`, or `hooray` on that issue; `prebuild` (`scripts/fetch-votes.ts`) snapshots those reaction counts into `src/generated/votes.json`.

## Install-Safety & Reproducibility Model

- **Pinned Upstream Refs**: `source.ref` and raw script URLs (`install.script.url`) must use an immutable 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA or version tag. Moving branch names (`main`, `master`, `dev`, `HEAD`, `latest`, `trunk`) are rejected by `isPinnedRef()` in `src/lib/schema.ts`.
- **SHA-256 Script Integrity**: Any external `install.script` requires a lowercase 64-character hex `sha256` digest displayed alongside a direct link to inspect the raw script source before execution.
- **Image Host Allowlist**: Screenshot URLs are restricted to `raw.githubusercontent.com`, `user-images.githubusercontent.com`, `private-user-images.githubusercontent.com`, `github.com`, `i.imgur.com`, and `i.redd.it` (plus local `/` paths).
- **Sanitized README Rendering**: Upstream READMEs are fetched from the pinned `source.ref` at build time, parsed with `marked`, and stripped of unsafe tags/attributes via `sanitize-html`.
